title: transit drain: Ok(_) swallows JoinError on ingestion task panic
description: In crates/transit/src/main.rs, the shutdown drain block matches drain_result with Ok(_). The type is Result<Result<(), JoinError>, Elapsed> — the Ok(_) arm covers both Ok(Ok(())) (clean exit) and Ok(Err(JoinError)) (task panicked), logging 'ingestion task drained cleanly' in both cases. A reader cold to this code cannot distinguish a clean shutdown from one that hid a panic. Fix: match Ok(Ok(_)) for the clean case and add an Ok(Err(e)) arm that logs the panic before exiting.
notes: opinion: Duplicate of nzr6.1 which is filed at P3 and is more complete. Both describe the same Ok(_) matching Ok(Err(JoinError)) and logging 'drained cleanly' on task panic. nzr6.1 should be the canonical issue. This P4 duplicate adds no new information.
